title: Admit committed task-sync envelopes by their Git blob size
outcome: A clean checkout whose CRLF conversion increases project.json beyond the per-file limit can still import a committed envelope within the raw Git bound.
acceptance: Committed task-sync admission uses the selected commit envelope and its raw size, including on the task-only path, while loose imports and explicit checkout comparison retain their bounded worktree read.
A clean CRLF-expanded checkout reproduces the former false refusal and imports the valid committed envelope without adding a Git start on ordinary import.
